headline: Assurant (AIZ) Stock Fair Value Edges Higher After Bullish Analyst Target Changes
summary: The latest update to the Assurant analyst narrative includes a small lift in the modelled fair value, from US$293 to about US$300.50, which many investors will see as a modest reset of the price target range. That move sits alongside recent bullish commentary that highlights what analysts view as solid execution in property and casualty insurance and ongoing contribution from Connected Living. Read on to see how this evolving narrative might shape the way you track Assurant from here. Stay...
